facts.statement: Free Realms showed a new wave of images at San Diego Comic-Con 2009 displaying a new side of the game.
facts.quote: San Diego Comic-Con 2009 brought on a new wave of Free Realms images showing off a whole new side of the game.

article_summaries.title: New Free Realms Images from San Diego Comic-Con 2009
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer image-gallery post from San Diego Comic-Con 2009 teasing upcoming Free Realms features: player garages, demo derby and kart racing with driver progression, and Sandstorm and Thunder Speedways. The text is brief and gives no mechanics, numbers or dates beyond the posting date; the gallery itself is not in the extracted text.
